# LogistiCore Technologies

> LogistiCore SaaS is a UK freight forwarding and logistics platform — air, sea, road, courier, warehouse, HMRC CDS customs, billing and AI. Complementary IT support and website services available for the same logistics teams.

- Site: https://logisticoreapp.com
- Platform: https://logisticoreapp.com/logisticore-saas.html
- App login: https://app.logisticoreapp.com/app/login
- Sales: sales@logisticoreapp.com
- Support: support@logisticoreapp.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 20 4511 4156

## Primary product

- [LogistiCore SaaS / Platform](https://logisticoreapp.com/logisticore-saas.html): Freight forwarding software for UK forwarders, brokers, and 3PLs
- [Partner programme](https://logisticoreapp.com/partners.html): Reseller, referral, implementation, and technology partnerships
- [Pricing](https://logisticoreapp.com/pricing.html)
- [Contact / book a demo](https://logisticoreapp.com/contact.html?enquiry=saas)
